# sharepoint_app_catalog_app (Resource)

Uploads a local SPFx solution package (.sppkg) to a SharePoint app catalog and, by default, deploys/publishes it (m365 spo app add [--overwrite] + m365 spo app deploy). Re-applies (re-uploads) automatically whenever the file at file_path changes, detected via a SHA-256 hash of its contents. Setting deploy back to false after an app has already been deployed does NOT retract it — this provider only ever uploads/deploys, never retracts — deploy=false only skips the deploy step on the next upload. Use the resulting id as the app_id input to sharepoint_spfx_solution_install to install this app on a site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Upload a local .sppkg to the tenant app catalog and deploy it.
resource "sharepoint_app_catalog_app" "header" {
  file_path = "${path.module}/packages/contoso-header.sppkg"
  deploy    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_path` (String) Absolute or relative path (resolved by the m365 CLI, not this provider) to the .sppkg file to upload.

### Optional

- `app_catalog_scope` (String) Scope of the app catalog to upload to: tenant or sitecollection. Defaults to tenant.
- `app_catalog_url` (String) URL of the site collection app catalog. Required when app_catalog_scope is "sitecollection"; ignored for the tenant scope.
- `deploy` (Boolean) Whether to deploy/publish the package after uploading it, making it installable on sites. Defaults to true.
- `skip_feature_deployment` (Boolean) For solutions that support tenant-wide deployment, deploy the app to the whole tenant instead of requiring per-site installation. Passed as --skipFeatureDeployment to `m365 spo app deploy`. Only takes effect when deploy is true.

### Read-Only

- `app_catalog_version` (String) Version of the package currently in the app catalog.
- `can_upgrade` (Boolean) Whether sites with this app installed have a pending upgrade available (mirrors the CanUpgrade field used by sharepoint_spfx_solution_install).
- `deployed` (Boolean) Whether the app is currently deployed/published in the app catalog.
- `file_hash` (String) SHA-256 hash of the file at file_path, computed at plan time to detect local changes. When it differs from the last-applied hash, apply re-uploads (and, if deploy is true, redeploys) the package.
- `id` (String) App catalog GUID assigned to the uploaded package, as reported by `m365 spo app get`/`app add`.
- `product_id` (String) ProductId of the SPFx solution (from package-solution.json). This is what sharepoint_spfx_solution_install matches installed instances against.
- `title` (String) Display title of the app, as reported by the app catalog.
